title: HelloToken FlashLoan
description:
My project is a simple flash loan project that protect user from liquidation with leverage from Aave and 1inch protocol. When ever there is a price drop happens, liquidation can be protected with a leverage for short term and protects the capital.

My goal of participating in the hackathon is to identify the vulnerability in the FlashLoan between multiple protocols and i found a vulnerability too. I will disclose that with a proof of concept and repeatable contract.

Project is partially developed. From the project i am confident on the following. 

1.Solidity
2.FlashLoan
3.Internals of LendingPoolProviders and LendingPools (changable)
4.How flashloan works ?
5.How FlashLoan arbitrage works ?

As a ethical hacker point of view, i think, i  found a vulnerability in the FlashLoan still i am exploring and creating a proof of concept. Once the vulnerability is confirmed i will report that to Aave with sensible reporting procedure and save the people's fund from hackers and exploiters.
